Three people, including his driver and an autorickshaw driver, were injured in the incident, police said. The Lawrence Bishnoi gang has claimed the attack after gangster Anil Pandit said he, along with Harman Sandhu, was behind the attack. Pandit warned that until the actors stop working with Bollywood actor Salman Khan , the attacks will continue. “Anyone in the Mumbai film industry who does not listen to us or works with Salman Khan will be next. Wait and watch.” According to initial information, Shroff was returning after playing football at a club when the three unidentified assailants opened fire near Pushpa Park in Juhu . Three people have reportedly been injured, including Shroff's driver Firdos who suffered injuries on his hand, police said. Upon receiving news of the incident, the Mumbai Police officials and ambulances arrived at the scene. The police have cordoned off the area and fifteen police teams have been dispatched to trace the assailants. Currently, the police are examining footage from CCTV cameras installed in the vicinity. Multiple rounds were fired at the building, though no one was injured. One bullet struck the glass of a gym in the building; no injuries were reported.

news.headline: Kochi Mini Cooper crash: Driver’s mother appeals for privacy, extends condolences to victims’ families
news.story_lead: Kochi Mini Cooper crash: Driver’s mother appeals for privacy, extends condolences to victims’ families Suhail Sajeev’s mother said the investigation into the Mini Cooper crash must proceed in the right direction and that the truth must prevail A week after a 19-year-old rammed a Mini Cooper into a scooter, killing three people near Kochi, his mother appealed to the public to give her family some privacy as they navigate the aftermath of the horrific crash. Nooha Sajeev, who runs apparel stores in Kochi and Alappuzha under the brand ‘Iha Designs’, is the mother of Suhail Sajeev, who was arrested on October 11 in connection with the car accident that claimed three lives. In a video posted on Facebook, Nooha expressed her condolences to the families of the three victims.
news.full_article_text: Kochi Mini Cooper crash: Driver’s mother appeals for privacy, extends condolences to victims’ families Suhail Sajeev’s mother said the investigation into the Mini Cooper crash must proceed in the right direction and that the truth must prevail A week after a 19-year-old rammed a Mini Cooper into a scooter, killing three people near Kochi, his mother appealed to the public to give her family some privacy as they navigate the aftermath of the horrific crash. Nooha Sajeev, who runs apparel stores in Kochi and Alappuzha under the brand ‘Iha Designs’, is the mother of Suhail Sajeev, who was arrested on October 11 in connection with the car accident that claimed three lives. In a video posted on Facebook, Nooha expressed her condolences to the families of the three victims. "We have lost three valuable lives. I convey my condolences to their families. I can understand the pain they must be feeling. We raise our children with a lot of hopes and dreams, and when they suddenly leave us, it is unthinkable. My words can never compensate for their grief," Nooha said in the video. Also Read | Mini Cooper driver who killed 3 in Kochi car crash had 5 times legal blood alcohol limit, say police She said that the investigation must proceed in the right direction and that only truth must prevail. Nooha also requested the public to desist from spreading half-truths and give her family some privacy. "This issue is being discussed a lot on social media. Many people are angry at us. But I want to appeal for privacy for me and my family. There are a lot of half-truths going around. Please understand that I am also a woman and a mother hailing from an ordinary family. I am concerned about my son's future just as I am deeply sad about the three people who lost their lives," she said. The 19-year-old’s mother said she felt utterly “helpless” and had been unable to even sit up over the past few days. "Please remember that I have a family of four. We also have lives to go about," she said. This is the first time Nooha Sajeev has spoken publicly about the fallout of the October 11 car crash that led to her younger son, Suhail, being jailed. Nooha had gifted him the Mini Cooper on his birthday this year and shared the moment on Facebook. She had said then that both her sons were car enthusiasts and that she was “happy” to gift the luxury car to her younger son. news.full_article_text: CJP alleges Ashutosh, Saurav not being released; Delhi Police file FIR over threats to magistrate On October 14, he noted that Ranka and Das, who had previously signed a surety bond on October 11 to keep peace, breached it by entering Jantar Mantar. Almost four days after the Cockroach Janta Party's co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were sent to judicial custody for unfurling the national flag at Delhi's Jantar Mantar, the CJP has accused the Delhi Police of intentionally delaying the release of Ranka and Das for days and not accepting the surety bonds submitted by them. The Delhi Police on Sunday said the SEM hearing the case has received threats and lodged an FIR. Police denied allegations of delay and said due procedure is being followed. A special executive magistrate at Mandir Marg is yet to give an order to release the duo. Follow live updates on the Delhi protest here . Ranka and Das in judicial custody Deep Dive "Accordingly, it is hereby ordered that notice under Section 130 BNSS be issued to the respondents. Since no sound surety has been produced at this stage, and to maintain public peace and order, the respondents are remanded to Judicial Custody for a period of five days. List the matter on 19.10.26 for further enquiry," reads the order. Ranka and Das, along with a few other CJP members, had jumped gates to enter the de-notified Jantar Mantar protest site to unfurl the national flag on October 13. They were detained at the same time and put under arrest. Also Read | Delhi Police lodge 3 FIRs over CJP's Tiranga march; Abhijeet Dipke, Neha Bora released ‘Every day is a new struggle’: CJP national secretary The CJP said that since October 15, they have filed multiple surety bonds to get Ranka and Das released from judicial custody, but police are giving new excuses all the time. Aafreen Nawaz, CJP national secretary, told HT, “We have been sitting like watchdogs at the Mandir Marg police station for four days now. We were told that they will be released once we give surety bonds. Since then, we have been submitting it but they are rejecting. Also, we have been given so many excuses.” “At times, the SHO comes in the evening and not in the morning. The IO tells us he's stuck in traffic and arrives in the evening. One day, DCP Sachin Sharma delayed and didn't sign the bond. They then said our fixed deposits are not proper. But they already have bank stamps. They then said the names of the persons mentioned there don't have a Delhi address. They started picking up our volunteers and threatened them,” Nawaz added. "Every day is a new struggle. We have now filed multiple surety bonds. Taken help from top Supreme Court lawyers, but the police are not ready to accept. Today, they told Ratna Singh (CJP legal affairs head) that the SEM is getting threats if he releases the duo, and a new magistrate needs to come. The SEM also told the lawyers that Abhijeet, while leaving Delhi today, said the party needs to strategise. But he didn't mean any planning or protest. They are nitpicking statements from videos, delaying and giving lame excuses. Tomorrow, I'm sure there will be a holiday, and the procedure will get delayed again," the CJP national secretary stated. ‘They keep giving excuses’: Ratna Ratna on X has been sharing about the delay since Friday. On Sunday, she told the media, “The hearing was supposed to happen at 12 noon but was delayed till 5 pm. Today, everything was complete, the verification was done, and all requirements were met.” "Within about five minutes of the proceedings, the SEM told the court that he had received a threatening message and said he would come tomorrow. It was then that they started accusing us of sending the message. How is it related to the case? They keep giving excuses by not verifying sureties, or approving FDs. It was visible how they orchestrated this. We have followed all procedures, but they are not even ready to listen to the case. This is a conspiracy by Delhi Police. They just want to extend custody," Ratna noted. Meanwhile, the Delhi Police has not officially released a statement on the allegations, delay, and release of the duo. Ranka and Das have been lodged in Tihar jail since October 14. Also Read | CJP to 'restrategise after Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka's release': Abhijeet Dipke on anti-CEC stir ‘Faulty surety bonds’: What the police said Senior police officers said no delay was there and an FIR has been lodged on Sunday in New Delhi district for threatening the SEM Mandir Marg. The FIR was filed in SEM's c complaint under sections of criminal intimidation and threat. A senior police officer said, “They have been filing faulty surety bonds, and we can't accept them. We have to follow procedure. On Sunday evening, the SEM informed us he received threatening messages from CJP about the bail. He said he can't do the job under threat and at such risk. We have to delay the hearing. We have filed an FIR and are conducting an enquiry.” - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Jignasa Sinha Jignasa Sinha is a Special Correspondent at Hindustan Times in New Delhi. With more than six years of reporting experience, she covers crime and policing in the national capital. Her beats also include Delhi prisons, the Delhi Fire Services and Delhi courts, while she regularly reports on gender, labour and social justice. Over the course of her career, Jignasa has reported on major criminal investigations, international crime syndicates, high-profile cyber fraud cases, law-and-order developments, protests, disasters and public institutions. Her reporting combines breaking news with in-depth, long form, human interest stories that examine the human impact of public policy, policing and the criminal justice system. In addition to reporting for the newspaper, she contributes to the Hindustan Times website and app, and plays an active role in coordinating on-ground coverage of major developments and breaking news across Delhi. Before joining Hindustan Times, Jignasa worked at The Indian Express newspaper in New Delhi, where she spent five years covering crime, Delhi airport, courts and health. She began her journalism career as an intern at an AI magazine in Bengaluru while pursuing her postgraduate diploma in multimedia journalism at the Indian Institute of Journalism and New Media. Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Sunday condemned the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai’s Juhu area and said he had spoken to the actor and also the Mumbai Police Commissioner to ensure the assailants were apprehended swiftly. Fadnavis sought details of the incident from police commissioner Deven Bharti and asked him to nab the assailants quickly, expedite the investigation and take strict action against those responsible, news agency PTI reported. "We are all with you. We will track down the accused soon. Do not worry," Fadnavis, who holds the Home portfolio, told the actor. Maharashtra deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde also condemned the firing incident, calling it “deeply concerning”. He said he had spoken to both the Mumbai Police Commissioner and Shroff following the incident. Shinde said the police had formed several teams to identify and arrest those responsible, adding that the government would not tolerate attempts by gangs to spread fear in the city. Deep Dive “Tiger Shroff’s vehicle was targeted. This incident is deeply concerning and condemnable; I condemn it in the strongest possible terms. I have spoken with the Police Commissioner, and I have also spoken with Tiger Shroff. The Mumbai Police Commissioner has formed several teams to track down those who opened fire—they will be apprehended and given a response in their own language. Our current priority is to keep Mumbai and its citizens safe.” Emphasising that the safety of every citizen, regardless of whether they are a celebrity or an ordinary person, remained a top priority, he warned that those involved would face action and no gang would be spared. “Whether it is a celebrity or an ordinary citizen, ensuring their safety is the responsibility of the police and the government, and there will be no negligence in this regard. No gang will be spared; we will not let them get away with this." "We have seen large-scale gang wars like this before, back in the 1990s. Even then, the Mumbai Police effectively handled the situation—they dealt with the perpetrators in their own language, ensuring that law and order were maintained. So, any gang attempting to spread terror here should think twice. This is Mumbai; this is Maharashtra,” Shinde told reporters. ‘Criminals no longer fear law’: Supriya Sule NCP President Supriya Sule took a jibe at Maharashtra’s law and order situation, calling it ‘extremely alarming.” She questioned the situation of the state in which “criminals no longer fear the law” and urged the home minister to take appropriate measures to reassure the public. “An incident has come to light where actor Tiger Shroff was targeted in a shooting in Mumbai. Shootings are continuously surfacing across the state, and the situation is such that criminals no longer fear the law. Fortunately, while the actor was not injured in this incident, it is understood that some individuals sustained injuries," she wrote in a post on X. “In broad daylight, on busy streets, criminals are brandishing swords and firing shots. This picture of the law and order situation in Maharashtra is extremely alarming. As a result, citizens are living in fear and are anxious about their safety. I request the Honorable Home Minister to please immediately review the law and order situation in the state and take appropriate measures to reassure the public.” ‘Very sad’: Piyush Goyal Union minister Piyush Goyal called it a “very sad incident” and expressed confidence in police, saying necessary action will be taken to arrest the accused. “This is a very sad incident. I am confident that the police will take necessary action and arrest the accused,” he told news agency ANI. Congress leader Varsha Gaikwad also condemned the incident and raised concerns over Mumbai’s security and law-and-order situation. Citing previous incidents of firing outside actor Salman Khan’s residence and filmmaker Rohit Shetty’s residence, as well as the killing of veteran politician and Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) leader Baba Siddique, she questioned the safety of the city’s residents. "The firing was carried out by an unidentified person. However, this once again raises questions about how poor Mumbai's security and law-and-order situation has become. We have earlier seen firing outside Salman Khan's house. Unfortunately, Baba Siddique was shot dead, and firing also took place outside Rohit Shetty’s house. If Mumbai, the country's financial capital, whose police force was once compared to Scotland Yard, is in such a state, I want to ask: if politicians and actors are not safe in Mumbai, what will be the condition of the common man?” news agency PTI reported. AIMIM leader Waris Pathan also condemned the firing incident, raising concerns over Mumbai’s law-and-order situation and questioning how armed assailants could open fire in a crowded area such as Juhu. Pathan warned against a return to the era of underworld activity and threats to Bollywood personalities. He called for an immediate investigation and strict action against those involved, holding the government accountable for ensuring public safety. "In a place like Mumbai, on a Sunday, in the Juhu area, which is such a populated area where entire families visit Juhu Beach during the time of Navratri, some goons came to such a place and opened fire on Bollywood star Tiger Shroff, a young guy. ...What has happened to Mumbai? Do people want to take Mumbai back to the 90s era, when the underworld was active, film stars were threatened, and open firing took place? Shots were fired at Salman Khan, then at Rohit Shetty's home, and now this happened on a Sunday evening.” “What is the police doing? ...Whatever the extent of truth, this is a very serious and grave matter. The police should immediately conduct an investigation and take strict action against whoever is involved. We do not want Mumbai to go back to that era. Ensure safety, what is the government doing? When the government strays from its priorities, such incidents start happening. This is a total failure of law and order." news.headline: CRPF chief lauds woman personnel for showing ‘resilience’ after being slapped during CJP protest
news.story_lead: CRPF chief lauds woman personnel for showing ‘resilience’ after being slapped during CJP protest The Delhi Police have filed an FIR against an unidentified protester for ‘slapping’ the official near Connaught Place on Friday during CJP's Tiranga march. The chief of the Central Reserved Police Force on Sunday commended a woman CRPF personnel for showing restraint on duty when she was allegedly heckled and assaulted by a woman protester on Friday during the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)'s ‘Lehra Do Tiranaga’ march. CRPF director general (DG) GP Singh said the woman officer, who is a top judo practitioner and part of the CRPF’s judo team, displayed “extreme patience, perseverance and resilience” despite being assaulted.

The Delhi Police have already filed an FIR against an unidentified protester who allegedly slapped and assaulted the official near Palika Bazaar, close to Rajiv Chowk Metro Station in Connaught Place on Friday evening during CJP's Tiranga march. The police on Saturday said that they registered at least three FIRs against protesters for allegedly violating prohibitory orders, taking out a flag march that affected law and order, and obstructing police personnel in the discharge of their duties. We remain committed to peace and order in the country. Lawful action is being taken by jurisdictional police in the matter.” The nine-second video, widely circulated on social media platforms on Saturday, shows the woman confronting the security personnel before slapping her. Police personnel can also be seen using whistles to disperse protesters. Delhi Police said they are identifying the woman for legal action in the matter. - Cockroach Janta Party

At least 19 people were killed and 25 were injured in a stampede at a prominent puja pandal in central Kolkata on Saturday evening. While police arrested seven persons and booked them under sections dealing with culpable homicide not amounting murder, West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the state government would set up a Special Investigation Team (SIT) headed by a sitting judge of the Calcutta high court to probe into the incident. Also read: Rain, a rush and a mic warning: The chain of events behind Kolkata’s Durga Puja stampede that killed 19 Deep Dive “The chief secretary will write to the Chief Justice of the Calcutta high court in this regard. It is up to the Chief Justice whether he allows a sitting judge to head the SIT. Else we will appoint a retired judge of the Calcutta high court to head the SIT,” Adhikari said. CM announces ex-gratia relief The chief minister announced government job and ex-gratia of ₹ 25 lakh for the next of kin of each of those who were killed in the accident. The injured would be given ₹ 5 lakh each and the state would bear their medical expenses. Also read: 'There was no way out': Families mourn loss of loved ones in Durga Puja stampede that killed 19 Union home minister Amit Shah, who had come to Kolkata on Saturday, cancelled all his puja-related programmes and visited the injured at the hospital. Of the 25 injured, two were admitted in the ICU with fractures. “I will try to visit the families who have lost their members on October 20 and 21,” Adhikari said. Later in day the chief minister held a high-level meeting with senior police officials and bureaucrats across the state to take stock of the security arrangements in big-ticket pujas. He also monitored crowd and traffic management in Kolkata and other cities in the state from the police control rooms. A committee headed by the state disaster management secretary and comprising officers from fire department and Special Task Force will visit the prominent pujas in Kolkata and make recommendations whether any rectifications need to be made. “If needed crowd will be restricted. There will be no separate queues for VIPs. We will do whatever it takes,” he said. Meanwhile, preliminary probe by the police revealed that an announcement by the puja organisers on Saturday evening that the Chorebagan pandal could collapse while urging people to vacate the pandal triggered the stampede. Also read: ‘Pandal will collapse, please leave’: Warning over mic set off Kolkata stampede, 19 dead The pandal which received an award from state government was registering heavy footfall over the past few days. On Saptami too thousands had thronged the pandal. “As rain hit pandal hoppers tried to take shelter inside the pandal. Those inside the pandal refused to go out. People also started to push in from the exit resulting in the chaos which ultimately the stampede started,” said a local resident. Row after Chorbagan stampede Allegations surfaced that there were not enough police at the scene, cops didn’t help the victims, there was no ambulance and locals had to book app cabs to help victims reach the hospital. "Who made these allegations? The victims, whom I spoke to at the hospital, gave a different version. They said the police helped them and booked cabs to send them to the hospital. The allegations are mainly against some home guards recruited two years back (during the previous government). Some of them don't even know Bengali and have a language barrier. I have asked for a list of the homeguards," Adhikari said. Also read: SIT headed by sitting judge to probe Kolkata pandal stampede; CM announces ₹ 25 lakh aid, government job The Mamata All India Trinamool Congress aggressively targeted the government with spokesperson and Kolkata MLA Kunal Ghosh focusing on the fact that old members of the Chorebagan puja committee stepped down after the BJP came to power in May. Ritesh Tiwari, state BJP spokesperson and MLA from Kolkata's Kashipur-Belgachhia constituency, defended his colleagues. "For decades, TMC MLAs and ministers such as Partha Chatterjee, Aroop Biswas and Firhad Hakim have been closely associated with community Durga Pujas. Before that, veteran Congress leader Somem Mitra was also associated with pujas. What is wrong if some BJP leaders are associated with some pujas? The chief minister has ordered a probe and the police have arrested several people," Tiwari said. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Joydeep Thakur Joydeep Thakur is a Special Correspondent based in Kolkata. While some were lying on the road in unconscious state, some were ill and some gasping for breath. A few were injured and could hardly walk. “We carried a middle-aged woman on a plastic chair and took her to a cab. Her relative was with her. They rushed to the hospital and we went back to the spot to help others. There were many other locals who had started helping the victims,” he said. In a video that surfaced on social media, people could be seen carrying an unconscious young woman and rushing down the lane. “There were not enough police and organisers couldn’t be seen anywhere. It was the local residents who started the rescue operation. I helped an elderly man who had come with his grandson. I made the sit in an empty food stall and arranged water from a house. I told them to wait there till the rush was over,” said Vivek Sonkar, another resident. A junior doctor, who did not wish to be named, said injured victims and bodies were brought to the hospital in cabs and ambulances. Relatives and family members of the victims also arrived one after another. “Some of the victims were declared dead while some had fractures. Many had fallen ill due to the suffocation and pressure of crowd and stampede in the pandal,” he said. Allegations also surfaced that the state-run hospital lacked adequate facilities to treat the victims, forcing some of them to be referred to a private hospital. A section of junior doctors at Calcutta Medical College and Hospital told media persons that the hospital lacked proper trauma-care facilities, prompting the referrals. The junior doctors also said that critically injured road accident victims brought to the hospital are referred to SSKM Hospital or RG Kar Medical College and Hospital. “This is true. There is no proper facility at the CMCH for treating such trauma victims. The state health minister was seen on saying before television channels that victims would be treated at a private hospital. Several victims were referred to a private hospital on EM Bypass. This only implies that the state-run hospital can’t cater to such emergencies and disasters,” said Aniket Mahata, a prominent face of the RG Kar movement. “These are baseless allegations. Those who are making these allegations seem to be knowing everything. Why study in a medical college then? There are so many avenues. news.full_article_text: BJP wary as Jagan Mohan Reddy hints at shift towards INDIA bloc Senior BJP party leaders who spoke on condition of anonymity said the YSRCP joining the INDIA bloc will pave the way for a political shift not just in the state, but also in the neighbouring Telangana. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is closely watching developments in Andhra Pradesh where former chief minister and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) chief Jagan Mohan Reddy’s statement expressing support for the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and seeking electoral reforms is being perceived as an indication that the once “friendly party” could be moving towards the opposition bloc. Reddy on Sunday said the appointment of election commissioners should be independent of the government in power. He also expressed regret over his party’s support for the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, which governs the appointment of Election Commissioners in 2023. “Approving that, I am regretting it now,” Jagan said, while addressing the media. The former CM also expressed concerns over the SIR and said 4.6 million fake voters had been identified across the country, and the government had decided to proceed with the elections using an unrevised electoral roll. He alleged that the delimitation of divisions and wards had been carried out to favour the ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA) coalition. Earlier this week, Jagan, in a post on X, said, “A proactive approach always yields better results than a reactive stance. The system has a flaw that needs to be corrected. Trust in the electoral process must be restored. The arrests of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka do not solve anything; it only aggravates the situation. I empathise with @SauravDassss and @AshutoshRanka.” The tweet was seen as an endorsement of the CJP, which is part of the ongoing demonstrations in the Capital against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, for what they allege are irregularities in the conduct of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). The possible realignment also comes at a time when the BJP is scouting for support for the passage of the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty First Amendment) Bill, 2026 and the Delimitation Bill, which seeks to redraw boundaries based on the 2011 census and is necessary for implementing the 33% quotas for women in legislatures. The YSRCP has 8 MPs—four each in Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha. Even as it was not part of the ruling NDA, it was counted as a friendly party that supported the government on several key issues including the Citizenship Amendment Act; the abrogation of Article 370 and the farm laws. The BJP was counting on it to support the delimitation bill as well as the Constitutional Amendment bill that requires two-third majority, even though Reddy had asked the Union government to ensure that the southern states do not lose out on seats owing to better population control measures. The party had also demanded that the government’s assurance of proportionate increase in seats for southern states should be inserted in the text of the delimitation bill. The delimitation bill needs a simple majority for passage, which the NDA, with its numbers in both the Houses, can achieve—in the Lok Sabha, it has over 300 while the simple majority mark is 272 of 543 members; in the Rajya Sabha it has 153 of 245. But the ruling coalition falls short of 360 votes, required for the two-third majority in the Lower House and 164 required in the Upper House for the passage of the Constitutional Amendment Bill. On the political impact of the realignment, BJP leaders said the coming together of Reddy and the Congress in Andhra Pradesh will pose a challenge to the ruling Telugu Desam Party (TDP), a key ally of the BJP-led NDA. And in Telangana too, the BJP, will have to contest against a formidable opponent. “Of late, there have been indications that the YSRCP will join the INDIA bloc. If that were to happen then the opposition will gain support from the larger coalition of Christian and Muslim voters in AP. The percentage of Christian voters is high in AP and they support Jagan, they also have a significant presence in Telangana, which the Congress will benefit from,” said a BJP leader. In AP, Christians are 1.37% of the electorate while Muslims are a little over 9%; in Telangana Christians are 1.27%, and Muslims are a little over 12%. “However, estimates put the percentage of Christians at 10-15% in both the states, as many practising Christians who are originally Dalits continue to identify as Hindus for reservation benefits,” said the leader. Explaining the shift in votes, he said that if the YSRCP aligns with the Congress, the Reddys in Telangana too will shift alliance to CM Revanth Reddy. “There is a significant settler vote (voters who shifted from Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema but are registered voters in Telangana) that is crucial in 20-30 constituencies in Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) region, in places such as Gachibowli, Khammam, and Suryapet, which the Congress will gain if the realignment occurs,” the leader said. However, a second party leader said Reddy’s statements came close on the heels of the CBI and the Enforcement Directorate (ED), which are probing cases against the former CM, moving the court to seek a daily trial. “This is a fight for survival. The issue of vote chori that the opposition has raised has no traction on the ground here…” the second leader said. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Smriti Kak Ramachandran Smriti covers an intersection of politics and governance. news.headline: CJI Inaugurates Ladakh High Court Bench and Announces Single-Day Virtual Supreme Court Hearings for the Region
news.story_lead: Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant has inaugurated the Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, establishing a dedicated judicial presence in the high-altitude region. To eliminate geographical and financial barriers for litigants and advocates, the CJI announced that all Supreme Court cases originating from Ladakh will be grouped on a single day and conducted virtually.
news.full_article_text:
### Key Judicial Infrastructure Development in Ladakh

Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant inaugurated the Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, bringing formal high court proceedings directly to the Union Territory. Situated at an elevation of roughly 3,500 metres above sea level, the bench represents the highest-altitude high court setup in India.

### Virtual Access Mechanism for Supreme Court Cases

To address the immense physical distance and financial hardship associated with traveling to New Delhi, the Supreme Court plans to implement a special virtual hearing protocol:
* **Consolidated Listing:** All legal matters originating from the Ladakh region will be grouped and listed for hearing on a single designated day.
* **Virtual Arguments:** Lawyers from the Leh and Kargil bar associations will be able to argue cases before the Supreme Court via video-conferencing directly from the Ladakh High Court bench.
* **Continuous Hearing:** The apex court will hear these listed matters on a day-to-day virtual basis until disposition.

### Historical Context and Geographical Challenges

During the event, CJI Surya Kant highlighted the long judicial history of the region, noting that a Special Court was first established in Leh in 1870. Following the creation of the Union Territory of Ladakh in 2019, 'Ladakh' was officially added to the title of the High Court. However, winter connectivity issues across the Great Himalayas historically forced litigants to rely almost exclusively on air travel to access high court benches.

### Strengthening Legal Aid and Local Dispute Resolution

CJI Kant stressed that technology and legal aid serve as crucial tools for judicial inclusion. Key initiatives outlined include:
* Active involvement of the Ladakh Legal Services Authority and the court's Legal Services Committee.
* Utilization of para-legal volunteers, legal awareness camps, and Lok Adalats to resolve grievances at the grassroots level.
* Recognition of traditional community dispute resolution mechanisms and village institutions that have long functioned in the region.

Following the reorganisation of the state into Union Territories in 2019, 'Ladakh' was formally incorporated into the official title of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. Prior to this, accessing the high court involved severe winter travel constraints across the Great Himalayas.

hindi_translation.headline: सीजेआई ने लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय पीठ का उद्घाटन किया; लेह और कारगिल के वकीलों के लिए वर्चुअल सुप्रीम कोर्ट सुनवाई की घोषणा की
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश जस्टिस सूर्य कांत ने जम्मू और कश्मीर तथा लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय की लद्दाख पीठ का उद्घाटन किया, जिससे इस उच्च पर्वतीय क्षेत्र में एक समर्पित न्यायिक उपस्थिति स्थापित हुई है। दूरस्थ भौगोलिक स्थिति और वित्तीय बाधाओं को समाप्त करने के लिए सीजेआई ने घोषणा की कि लद्दाख से संबंधित सभी मामलों को एक ही दिन सूचीबद्ध करके सुप्रीम कोर्ट में वर्चुअल तरीके से सुना जाएगा।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### लद्दाख में प्रमुख न्यायिक बुनियादी ढांचे का विकास

भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश जस्टिस सूर्य कांत ने जम्मू और कश्मीर तथा लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय की लद्दाख पीठ का उद्घाटन किया, जिससे केंद्र शासित प्रदेश को सीधे उच्च न्यायालय की कार्यवाही की सुविधा मिल सकेगी। समुद्र तल से लगभग 3,500 मीटर की ऊंचाई पर स्थित यह पीठ भारत में सबसे अधिक ऊंचाई पर स्थित उच्च न्यायालय की पीठ है।

### उच्चतम न्यायालय के मामलों के लिए वर्चुअल पहुंच तंत्र

नई दिल्ली की यात्रा से जुड़े भारी समय और वित्तीय कठिनाइयों को दूर करने के लिए उच्चतम न्यायालय एक विशेष वर्चुअल सुनवाई व्यवस्था लागू करेगा:
* **समेकित सूचीबद्धता:** लद्दाख क्षेत्र से उत्पन्न होने वाले सभी कानूनी मामलों को एक ही निश्चित दिन पर सुनवाई के लिए सूचीबद्ध किया जाएगा।
* **वर्चुअल बहस:** लेह और कारगिल बार एसोसिएशन के वकील सीधे लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय पीठ से वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से सुप्रीम कोर्ट के समक्ष मामले पेश कर सकेंगे।
* **सतत सुनवाई:** शीर्ष अदालत इन मामलों को निपटारे तक प्रतिदिन वर्चुअल आधार पर सुनेगी।

### ऐतिहासिक संदर्भ और भौगोलिक चुनौतियाँ

कार्यक्रम के दौरान सीजेआई सूर्य कांत ने क्षेत्र के लंबे न्यायिक इतिहास का उल्लेख करते हुए बताया कि 1870 में लेह में एक विशेष अदालत की स्थापना की गई थी। 2019 में लद्दाख के केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बनने के बाद उच्च न्यायालय के नाम में 'लद्दाख' जोड़ा गया था। हालाँकि, सर्दियों में महान हिमालयी क्षेत्र के कारण केवल हवाई यात्रा ही एकमात्र माध्यम रह जाती थी।

### कानूनी सहायता और स्थानीय विवाद समाधान को सुदृढ़ बनाना

सीजेआई कांत ने जोर देकर कहा कि तकनीक और कानूनी सहायता न्यायिक समावेश के आवश्यक साधन हैं। प्रमुख पहलों में शामिल हैं:
* लद्दाख कानूनी सेवा प्राधिकरण और अदालत की कानूनी सेवा समिति की सक्रिय भागीदारी।
* पैरा-लीगल स्वयंसेवकों, कानूनी जागरूकता शिविरों और लोक अदालतों के माध्यम से जमीनी स्तर पर शिकायतों का निवारण।
* क्षेत्र में लंबे समय से काम कर रही पारंपरिक सामुदायिक विवाद समाधान प्रणालियों और ग्रामीण संस्थाओं को मान्यता देना।
